summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py gains `import enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) class with eleven members, each commented. botocore/args.py gains the EPRBuiltins import, a None-tolerant endpoint_config in _should_set_global_sts_endpoint, and ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults. tests/unit/test_args.py gains TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 22 tests covering each behavioral criterion. Results: test_args.py, test_regions.py, and test_client.py pass (415 tests). The full tests/unit run shows 11 failures in test_awsrequest.py and two TestSessionComponent tests; the same 11 fail on the unmodified tree, so they predate this change. Not verified: black and isort are not in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand and by a line-length scan (no added line over 79 columns). Nothing committed.
